title: ジャパンCの後に・覇王のその先へ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a fierce battle, Meisho Doto wins against T.M. Opera O. At last, the two establish a rivalry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto is delighted by this new development in their relationship, while T.M. Opera O is excited to have someone who will encourage her growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The change is not only internal: their lap times also show improvement, convincing Air Shakur the two have broken past their previous stat ceiling.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's no longer certain who will emerge victorious in the race against the previous generation. The two head for the Arima Kinen as true competitors.
